description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Loss Ratio (%) and TFLOPs for five different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and uses a non-linear scale with specific tick marks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, and then in regular increments of 1e8 from 2e8 up to 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and features a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 94 to 100 at intervals of 1. The plot contains five solid lines. The first line, denoted by a solid grey rectangle in the legend, is purple with upward-pointing triangle markers; it remains constant at a value of exactly 100 across the entire x-axis from 1e7 to 9e8. The line labeled "SepLLM (n=64)" is orange with plus sign markers; it begins at approximately 98.3 at 1e7, rises to a peak of roughly 100.4 at 4e8, and ends at approximately 100 at 9e8. The line labeled "SepLLM (n=128)" is dark blue with cross markers; it starts at roughly 97.0 at 1e7, increases to about 99.8 at 2e8, and remains relatively steady just below 100, ending at approximately 99.7 at 9e8. The line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)" is green with diamond markers; it begins at approximately 97.5 at 1e7, rises to about 99.9 at 2e8, reaches a peak of roughly 100.2 at 6e8, and finishes at approximately 99.9 at 9e8. Finally, the line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" is red with circular markers; it starts at 94.0 at 1e7, exhibits a steep increase to approximately 98.5 at 2e8, reaches a local maximum of about 99.1 at 4e8, dips to roughly 98.4 at 5e8, and ends at approximately 98.7 at 9e8.
